spec_match.rationale: Fixed 2026-11-15: the never-matching `(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` branch inside @container is replaced by `tile style(--roomy: on)`, with the reduced-motion media query setting --roomy; the page now explicitly teaches that a media feature inside @container parses but never matches. The 360px trigger frame now uses box-sizing: content-box so its queried inline-size is exactly 360px and matches.

interactive.rationale: Show-all / Hide >= 360 / --roomy flag (follow OS, forced on, forced off) / Read conditionText all change observable output.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Lede and the rule section now describe the size branch + style() branch fed by the reduced-motion preference.

edge_cases.rationale: A notice appears if the comma-separated CSSContainerRule is missing from CSSOM (parser-dropped in pre-150 browsers), instead of blank verdicts; default verdict is "no match" so no tile is ever blank.

references.rationale: Links https://chromestatus.com/feature/6196591858941952 and the CSS Conditional 5 container-rule section.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite asserts real parse/CSSOM/round-trip/unknown-branch contracts and fails honestly in this browser (1 pass / 4 fail / 0 blocked) — it genuinely distinguishes supporting browsers.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright (NOT chrome-devtools-mcp, unavailable in this cloud session) against a local server, desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch: initial 220/280 no match, 360/540/720 match; --roomy forced on -> all match; emulated prefers-reduced-motion: reduce -> all match; conditionText reads "tile (min-width: 360px), tile style(--roomy: on)"; zero console errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: Baseline injected telemetry only; no page-level events for the CSSOM readback or match-state transitions.

design_system.rationale: Colours come from variables (including a color-mix of --accent-emerald), --font-display exists, and .ctl.on overrides background and color together.

accessibility.rationale: View toggles expose aria-pressed; the --roomy button states its mode in its label (no aria-pressed, per guidance); polite role=status summary of observed verdicts; #cssom-out is aria-live.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Frames scroll horizontally inside their cards; 0px document overflow at 360x740 and 1280x800.

summary: Weekly hardening 2026-11-15: replaced the impossible prefers-reduced-motion @container branch with a style(--roomy) branch bridged from @media, fixed the 360px trigger frame (content-box), contained fixed-width frames, added CSSOM capability notice, observed-verdict live summary and aria-pressed. Verified in headless Chromium 153 desktop+mobile with zero console errors.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Do not set container-type for style queries (every element is a style container); a style query only styles descendants of the element the property is set on, never that element itself.
There is no container-type for style queries; detect at-rule syntax support some other way than @supports at-rule().
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: support for comma-separated conditions is detected by comparing rendered/CSSOM state with the inputs, not with @supports.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Native buttons with programmatic state; announce dynamic state changes non-visually; do not add aria-pressed to a button whose label changes to describe its state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: aria-pressed on fixed-label toggles, polite role=status summaries.
